import ctypes
import sys

def gsl_ldexp_py(x, e):
    # Load libraries in correct order
    cblas = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")
    
    # Set up function prototype
    gsl.gsl_ldexp.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_int]
    gsl.gsl_ldexp.restype = ctypes.c_double
    
    # Call the function
    return gsl.gsl_ldexp(x, e)

def assert_test():
    # Test basic functionality
    assert abs(gsl_ldexp_py(3.0, 2) - 12.0) < 1e-10  # 3 * 2^2 = 12
    assert abs(gsl_ldexp_py(1.5, 3) - 12.0) < 1e-10  # 1.5 * 2^3 = 12
    
    # Test edge cases
    assert gsl_ldexp_py(0.0, 100) == 0.0
    assert abs(gsl_ldexp_py(1.0, 0) - 1.0) < 1e-10  # 1 * 2^0 = 1
    assert abs(gsl_ldexp_py(1.0, -1) - 0.5) < 1e-10  # 1 * 2^-1 = 0.5
    
    # Test large exponents
    large_result = gsl_ldexp_py(1.0, 1000)
    assert large_result != 0.0 and not ctypes.c_double(large_result).value == float('inf')
    
    # Test negative base
    assert abs(gsl_ldexp_py(-2.0, 2) + 8.0) < 1e-10  # -2 * 2^2 = -8
